build_sequential_module: build a Haiku Sequential module to chain multiple layers together in order
create_linear_layer: create a Haiku Linear layer with configurable output size, bias, and weight initialization
apply_dropout: apply dropout regularization to a JAX tensor with a configurable drop rate
convert_function_to_module: convert a plain Python function into a reusable Haiku Module class with to_module
batch_apply_callable: use BatchApply to merge leading dimensions before applying a callable to batched inputs
